tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// bde mchog brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis skye dang 'jig pa dag /ring du yongs su spangs gyur pa// sems can kun la thams cad du// phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyud rnams kun gyi don 'dzin cing*// sems can kun la phan brtson pa'i// kun mchog rdo rje 'dzin khyod la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rdzogs sangs rgyas las mngon sum du// khyod kyis chos rnams thugs chud de// mda' 'dzin spyod pa mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// thub pas thub par lung bstan cing*// chos rnams don ston klu sgrub mchog /bde ba can du gshegs pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// nyid kyis de nyid mchog thob nas// dman mos sems can don gyi phyir// rngon pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// yi ge'i sbyor ba spangs nas su// brtson pas nya rgyu gsol mdzad de// brtse bas gzhan don mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rgyal po'i bya ba rab spangs nas// sbrul 'tshong rjes su sgrub mdzad de// kāñtsi'i grong du grub pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// ye shes mkha' 'gros rjes gnang zhing*// gzhan don spyod pas don gsum mdzad// rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// dam pa'i de nyid don rtogs te// brtse bas rus sbal zhabs ldan pa// sems can smin par mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// khyod ni brtson pas grub brnyes pas// 'bar bas 'bar ba'i spyod pa 'dzin// kun la phan par mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// nus pa la ni mnga' brnyes shing*// spyod pa kun gyi rmad byung bas// 'jig rten 'dren par mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gu hya pa// brtse bas log 'dren rnal 'byor ma// 'dul nas 'gro ba skyong ba la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// mi mthun phyogs rnams rab spangs te// dkar po rnam par 'phel mdzad pa// rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs pad la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// grub nas grub pa'i lam ston cing*// grol nas rnam par phan mdzad pa// bar ma'i slob dpon dam pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// til brdungs pas ni rab grub pa// skal ldan gzhan la brtse ba can// mu stegs rnam par sun 'byin la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// bram ze las ni rab byung zhing*// gnas lnga la ni rab sbyangs ba// dka' bas dam pa bsten pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// shes bya la ni rab mkhas shing*// nus pa kun la thogs med pa// pha na phing gur grags pa la/

rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// skad gnyis smra ba'i mchog gyur cing*// shes rab ldan pas phan mdzad pa// brtsegs pa'i mtha' dang ldan pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// brtson pas dka' ba cher mdzad de// rgyud kun 'dzin mdzad skad gnyis smra// rje btsun blo gros grags pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mngon sum du// khyod la byin gyis brlabs pa yis// shes bya kun la thogs med ldan// rgyud kun gyi ni bdag por 'gyur// kun dga' snying por grags pa yi// dpal ldan sa skyar bzhugs gyur cing*// bde ba can du gshegs pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// gang gi sras kyi thu bo pa// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin brlabs pas// gnas lnga la ni rab mkhas shing*// bsod nams ye shes rtser gyur pa// nyid kyis gzhan don rdzogs mdzad nas// 'jig rten rnams ni gzhug pa'i phyir// bde ba can du gshegs pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// khyod kyi thugs ni 'jam dbyangs ltar// shes bya kun la ma rmongs shing*// 'jig rten kun la rtsa lag ltar// dgongs pa khyod kyi grags pa yis// rgyal mtshan dri ma med pa thob// ngo mtshar du ma'i spyod pa 'dzin// kun nas yon tan ldan khyod la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// brtse bas sems can thams cad la// dpal 'byor chen po'i 'od zer gyis// rtag tu skyong bar mdzad khyod la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// bdud dang mu stegs 'chi bdag sogs// rgol ba kun gyi nga rgyal 'joms// lha dang dge sbyong bram ze sogs// bstan pa dag la kun dga' mdzad// mtshungs pa med pa'i rgyal mtshan can// rmad du byung ba'i dpal mnga' ba// bzang po khyod kyi zhabs rdul la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// de ltar bdag ni dad pa yis// bla ma rnams dang phyogs bcu yi// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas rnams la// yang dang yang du gsol ba 'debs// bdag ni sems can kun don phyir// khyod la rtag tu 'bul lags na// brtse bas sems can don gyi phyir// khyed kyis rjes su gzung du gsol// bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas// kha na ma tho gang bgyis pa// de kun bla ma rnams la bdag

/slan chad bsdam pa'i bsam pas bshags// nang par sngar langs sems dwang bas// rtsa ba dang ni brgyud pa yi// bla ma rnams la gsol 'debs pa// de yi sdig pa ring du spong*// 'khor lo bde mchog gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa mdo khams kyi sa'i cha 'bri klung gi yul nas don du gnyer ba'i skye bo dag gis bskul ba'i ngor shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis dpal sa skya'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
